Name: Sounding Animated Furniture
Author: cassafrassarole
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I wanted something that sounded nice when the music died in-game, so I created this to give me something to hear while working on the farm. I thought I'd share with everyone since I've been working on it.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- The Bamboo Chimes are in regular, black, gold, wood, and seasonal-tree styles.
- The Deer Scare animates from spring to fall, and shows a static frozen sprite in winter.
- You can use the Deer Scare to refill your watering can in any season except winter.
- The README includes how to add your own chimes.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- Furniture Framework 3.2.4 or later
- Content Patcher 2.9.1 or later
